question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id FROM pizza_runner_orders WHERE cancellation IS NULL
),
order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT d.order_id, p.pizza_id
    FROM delivered_orders AS d
    JOIN pizza_customer_orders AS p ON d.order_id = p.order_id
),
pizza_counts AS (
    SELECT pizza_id, COUNT(*) as pizza_count
    FROM order_pizzas
    GROUP BY pizza_id
),
pizza_toppings_expanded AS (
    SELECT pc.pizza_id, pc.pizza_count, 
           TRIM(regexp_split_to_table(pr.toppings, ',')) as topping_id
    FROM pizza_counts AS pc
    JOIN pizza_recipes AS pr ON pc.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
ingredient_totals AS (
    SELECT pt.topping_id, SUM(pt.pizza_count) as total_quantity
    FROM pizza_toppings_expanded AS pt
    GROUP BY pt.topping_id
)
SELECT pt.topping_name, CAST(it.total_quantity AS INTEGER) as total_quantity
FROM ingredient_totals AS it
JOIN pizza_toppings AS pt ON it.topping_id = pt.topping_id
ORDER BY pt.topping_id
